brief:
Chris Sidoti, a UN commissioner, told Middle East Eye that Israel is deliberately targeting children in Gaza. Speaking on MEE's Expert Witness Podcast, Sidoti stated there is no ceasefire in place despite international negotiations on the matter.

The commissioner's remarks come as part of an ongoing UN inquiry into conduct during the conflict. His assertions add to documented reports of civilian casualties and military operations affecting Gaza's population.

title: UN commissioner accuses Israel of targeting children in Gaza
